info.title: Open Hadith Research Platform API
info.description:
Empirical, scholarly, and computational research platform for Hadith studies.

Dual database architecture:
- **Corpus Adapter (`hadiths_v2`)**: High-performance gateway into 1.13M classical Hadith occurrences, sanad chains, and biographical entries.
- **Research Platform (`hadith_research_platform`)**: Workspace isolation for scholars, hypothesis testing, lexical diffing, topological transmission analysis, and peer-reviewed monograph publishing.
